g.aria-label: The Core Obstacle: Parameters θ Govern the Distribution p_θ(x) Itself
Objective: ℓ(θ) = E_{X ~ p_θ}[g(X)] (VAEs: z ~ N(μ_θ, σ_θ²); RL Policy Gradients: a ~ π_θ(a|s))
Once a raw sample xᵢ ~ p_θ is drawn, it carries no computation graph back to θ!
Running Analytical Benchmark: X ~ N(θ, 1) (X = θ + Z, Z ~ N(0, 1))
ℓ(θ) = E[X²] = E[(θ + Z)²] = θ² + 1 ⇒ True derivative: ℓ′(θ) = 2θ
At θ = 1.5: ℓ(1.5) = 3.25 and exact slope is ℓ′(1.5) = 3.000 — our yardstick for every Monte Carlo estimator!
